name: aws-serverless-chatbot
description: AWS Serverless AI Chatbot using React, Node.js, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and OpenAI APIs with JWT Auth and Streaming Responses.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
